purpose: Single-candidate diagnostic follow-up to INT_C002 (ST_MTF_CONTROL_SHIFT_V1, PR #34) HOLD_SAMPLE_REQUIRED verdict from the parent campaign. Tests explanations C (timeframe derivation/data inadequacy) and D (adapter/replay mismatch via bounded tail windows) from docs/plans/AG_MTF_CONTROL_SHIFT_SAMPLE_ADEQUACY_R1.md by giving the engine genuine longer D1/H4 warm-up history instead of a bounded tail-window approximation. Does NOT change any strategy rule, threshold, or the parent prereg. This is NOT an EdgeLab economic gate, NOT LOGIC_VERIFIED criteria, and NOT a production promotion authority.
non_authority: Does not open or touch SEALED/OOS/FINAL_HOLDOUT data
Does not change strategies/registry.yaml or any production registry
Does not edit AG_OSS_STRATEGY_CANDIDATE_FACTORY_R1_PREREG_V1 (immutable, parent campaign closed)
amendment_policy: This file is immutable once committed. A further policy change requires a new PREREG_ID and a new campaign.

dev_datasets.purpose: D1/H4 derivation ONLY (never used to generate M15 decision occurrences or extend the decision population)
dev_datasets.composition: G2_DEV_002 EURUSD_H1.csv rows with timestamp_utc < 2025-09-14T21:00:00Z (2025-01-01T21:00:00Z .. 2025-09-12T20:00:00Z, 4368 rows) CONCATENATED with the unchanged HIST1Y EURUSD_H1.csv (2025-09-14T21:00:00Z .. 2026-09-15T21:00:00Z, 6241 rows). The two source files were verified byte-identical in their overlap window before concatenation (spot-checked candles match exactly) to rule out a silent data discontinuity.
dev_datasets.role: DEV / WARMUP_CONTEXT_ONLY for D1/H4 derivation. SSC_V1_0_1_G2_DEV_002's own dataset_manifest.json (built originally for a different strategy, ST_SESSION_SWEEP_CONTINUATION_V1) labels its pre-2026-06-21 H1 history as warmup_role.WARMUP_CONTEXT_ONLY=true, may_initialize_h1_bias=true, may_initialize_h1_structure=true, may_NOT_contribute_economic_sample_N, may_NOT_generate_decision_occurrence. This campaign independently adopts the identical restriction for the pre-HIST1Y portion: it is used only to seed D1/H4 structure/bias computation further back in time, never to add a new decision day outside the HIST1Y M15 window below.
dev_datasets.sealed_status: NOT_SEALED (data_role: DEVELOPMENT in its own manifest)
dev_datasets.broker_source: REAL_OBSERVED_MARKET (MT5-derived, same provenance chain as the parent campaign's HIST1Y dataset)

dev_datasets.note: UNCHANGED from the parent campaign (same files, same hashes). Used for the actual M15 decision population; this campaign does not extend or alter the decision window.

unchanged: strategy engine (byte-identical copy of PR #34, same provenance)
strategy rules, thresholds, session windows, symbol (EURUSD), cycles (ASIAN_LONDON, LONDON_NEWYORK)
M15 decision population (same days, same HIST1Y file)
H1 and M15 tail windows passed to evaluate() (H1=60, M15=150 bars, as in the parent run)
kill_policy thresholds (reused by reference from AG_CF_R1_DEV_SCREEN_V1, not re-derived)
changed: D1 and H4 are now derived from the full closed-to-date EXTENDED H1 series (no bounded tail window truncation: TAIL_D1/TAIL_H4 from the parent run, 40/80 bars, are REMOVED for this campaign) -- this directly tests whether the parent run's bounded-tail-window approximation (documented there as 'towards MORE NO_TRADE, never towards fabricating a signal') was material.

cost_model.note: UNCHANGED, reused by reference from the parent campaign. Only applied if min_trade_count is reached below; otherwise NOT_EVALUATED.

kill_policy.note: UNCHANGED, reused by reference from the parent campaign. Values copied verbatim for operator convenience; this file does not redefine them.

thresholds.friction_requirement: Net expectancy_R must remain > 0 under the BASE spread scenario with commission UNKNOWN explicitly disclosed (not zeroed).

kill_policy.if_sample_too_small: HOLD_SAMPLE_REQUIRED. min_trade_count is never lowered after seeing a result.
kill_policy.amendment: Any change to these thresholds requires a new kill_policy_id in a new prereg file; this campaign does not amend them.

stage_to_engine_mapping.CONTEXT: series validated + D1/H4 structure_bias computed (fails as HTF_BIAS_NOT_ALIGNED if NEUTRAL or mismatched)
stage_to_engine_mapping.LOCATION: fresh H4 POI exists and H1 has touched it (NO_FRESH_H4_POI, HTF_POI_NOT_REACHED)
stage_to_engine_mapping.H1_CONTROL_SHIFT: a recent, valid H1 control-shift zone exists (NO_VALID_H1_CONTROL_SHIFT, FALSE_CHOCH_*)
stage_to_engine_mapping.M15_REFINEMENT: an M15 entry refinement zone exists in-window after the H1 shift (NO_M15_ENTRY_REFINEMENT)
stage_to_engine_mapping.GEOMETRY: entry zone height and computed risk are positive (NON_POSITIVE_ENTRY_ZONE, NON_POSITIVE_RISK) and a valid HTF final target exists (NO_VALID_HTF_FINAL_TARGET)
stage_to_engine_mapping.SESSION: signal falls inside the declared session window (enforced structurally by the refinement filter, not a separate reason code)

diagnostic_funnel_protocol.purpose: Diagnose WHERE population reaches zero, not to optimize or loosen any filter. No threshold is adjusted based on funnel counts observed.

caps.note: This is a single-candidate (INT_C002) diagnostic follow-up: 2 replays = 2 cycles (ASIAN_LONDON, LONDON_NEWYORK). No new candidates are discovered or searched for.

gates_note: G1/G2/G3/G5 are unchanged from the parent campaign's INT_C002 record (research_external/candidate_factory/candidates/INT_C002.json) and are not re-run. Only G4 (causality/warm-up) is re-examined, since that is exactly what this experiment tests.
